evidence.statement: Biological coding representations may themselves evolve through conditionalization, grammar expansion, duplication/divergence, abstraction, distributed semantics, compatibility bridges, or implementation replacement.
LIFE-CODE must distinguish literal conservation from architectural/role equivalence and must not interpret missing literal sequence as proof of missing biological operation.

unknowns: Which evolutionary code transformations, if any, are empirically detectable in LIFE-CODE data.
Whether representation depth systematically changes with phylogenetic distance.
Whether architectural-role equivalence can be recovered prospectively after literal implementation replacement.
falsification_conditions: Prospective tests fail to find representation/grammar equivalence beyond standard literal or composition-driven conservation.
Purported evolutionary transformations disappear under matched phylogenetic/compositional controls.
